linkat (1.35.0-6, slicc_libc_gaps.c + slicc-linkat.js, slicc-kernel#563): tar.wasm imports env.__syscall_linkat; an archive with a hard-link member lists 'hl/b link to hl/a'; on slicc-kernel 1.88.0 (no wrapper) tar -x gives "tar: hl/b: Cannot hard link to ‘hl/a’: Too many links", rc 2, and still extracts hl/a; on 1.90.0 see extra_kernels. 1.35.0-5: no import (libc's weak stub answered EMLINK inside the wasm)
